name: Word Solitaire: Spell Cards
summary: Word Solitaire: Spell Cards is a single-player word puzzle game played with letter cards. Players spell words of 3 to 8 letters using the top cards of face-up piles, removing those cards to reveal the ones beneath. Two set-aside slots hold cards for later use, and clearing every pile and slot completes a deal. The game features daily puzzles, unlimited undo, multiple language-specific word lists, and accessibility settings, with no timer or lives. The iOS version includes over 200 deals, while the browser version offers the first 50 deals and a separate daily puzzle.
